note: Zenodo deposit registry for the Ukrainian Frequency datasets (WO-2). One deposit per dataset because the licenses differ. conceptDoi is the version-independent DOI Zenodo assigns on the first publish; scripts/ukrainian-frequency/zenodo-deposit.mjs fills it in and mints a new version DOI under it on every release. null means not deposited yet. The site pages and the uavocab package read this file; never hand-edit a DOI. A deposit may carry `contributors`: [{name: "Last, First", type?}], the named reviewers whose accepted corrections the next version carries, sent to Zenodo as contributors (Researcher by default). Add a name only after the person has agreed in writing (owner decision 2026-11-07: reviewers are credited on the dataset, not paid per answer).

frequency.title: Ukrainian Frequency: a lemma-based, coverage-graded open frequency list for modern Ukrainian (top 12,000, over UberText 2.0)

validated-cefr.title: Ukrainian Frequency: the PULS CEFR overlay (validated A1 to C1 levels joined onto the top-12,000 list)

minimums-crosswalk.title: A crosswalk of the Ukrainian lexical minimums (Borodin et al., A1 and A2) against the validated Ukrainian Vocabulary Profile
minimums-crosswalk.holdReason: Every row carries a PULS level (CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 since 2026-09-24). The license notice the hold waited on is posted (https://puls.peremova.org/terms, read 2026-11-20), but the crosswalk carries levels for all 10,194 profiled lemmas, past the list's scope the authors were told about; held until they answer the scope question of 2026-11-15 (docs/ukrainian-frequency/puls-correspondence.md).

b1-enrichment.title: Ukrainian Frequency: the B1 enrichment tables (aspect relations, case government, collocations)

stress.title: Ukrainian Frequency: word stress for every lemma of the top-12,000 list (over ukrainian-word-stress, en.wiktionary and uk.wiktionary)
